label.translation: Flips the positive direction of all faces on a selected surface body.

label.translation: Select a surface body to reverse.

label.devLabel: Combines the selected faces into a single quilt surface.
label.translation: Combines the selected faces into a single quilt surface.

label.translation: Select the faces to merge. You can select solid or surface faces.

label.devLabel: Creates a new midsurface shell from the selected body.
label.translation: Creates a new midsurface shell from the selected body.

label.translation: Creates a new surface body at a given distance from the selected face or surface body.

label.translation: Select a face or surface body to offset, then specify the distance.

label.translation: Creates a new offset shell at a given distance from the selected face.

label.devLabel: Select the face to offset then specify the distance.
label.translation: Select the face to offset then specify the distance.

label.devLabel: Creates a planar or 3D surface within the boundary of a specified closed loop.
label.translation: Creates a planar or 3D surface within the boundary of a specified closed loop.

label.translation: Select the loop to patch then apply connected (G0), tangent (G1), and curvature (G2) boundary conditions.

label.devLabel: Creates a ruled surface at a specified distance and angle from selected edges.
label.translation: Creates a ruled surface at a specified distance and angle from selected edges.

label.translation: Select edges on a solid body, surface body, or sketch. Then select a ruled surface type and specify the direction, distance, and angle.

label.devLabel: Creates a new surface shell from the surface.
label.translation: Creates a new surface shell from the surface.

label.devLabel: Select the surface to surface shell.
label.translation: Select the surface to surface shell.

label.devLabel: Joins surfaces to make a single surface body or solid body.
label.translation: Joins surfaces to make a single surface body or solid body.

label.devLabel: Select the surfaces to join. Edges within the tolerance are highlighted green.
label.translation: Select the surfaces to join. Edges within the tolerance are highlighted green.

label.devLabel: Removes the selected area of a surface body using the specified cutting tool.
label.translation: Removes the selected area of a surface body using the specified cutting tool.

label.devLabel: Select the cutting tool to use then select faces or surface bodies to remove.
label.translation: Select the cutting tool to use then select faces or surface bodies to remove.

label.devLabel: Breaks joined surfaces into individual surfaces.
label.translation: Breaks joined surfaces into individual surfaces.

label.devLabel: Select faces to unstitch. The selected face is unhooked from the parent body and the result body contains the unhooked face.
label.translation: Select faces to unstitch. The selected face is unhooked from the parent body and the result body contains the unhooked face.

label.devLabel: Extends trimmed surfaces and fills gaps, holes, or empty regions.
label.translation: Extends trimmed surfaces and fills gaps, holes, or empty regions.

label.devLabel: Select the surface to untrim, then select the untrim type. You can untrim all edges, internal edges, external edges, or manually select the edges you want to untrim.
label.translation: Select the surface to untrim, then select the untrim type. You can untrim all edges, internal edges, external edges, or manually select the edges you want to untrim.

label.devLabel: Checks the quality of selected surfaces and attempts to heal surfaces before stitching into quilts and solids.
label.translation: Checks the quality of selected surfaces and attempts to heal surfaces before stitching into quilts and solids.

label.devLabel: Select the surfaces to check, specify a tolerance then select the type of validation to perform.
label.translation: Select the surfaces to check, specify a tolerance then select the type of validation to perform.

label.devLabel: Select the surfaces to merge. You can select solid or surface faces.
label.translation: Select the surfaces to merge. You can select solid or surface faces.

label.devLabel: The use of shells can reduce mesh requirements and solve time. Using this command on a complex body may require slight adjustments with other shellcommands such as Gap Fill.
label.translation: The use of shells can reduce mesh requirements and solve time. Using this command on a complex body may require slight adjustments with other shellcommands such as Gap Fill.

label.devLabel: Creates a shell part in the middle of the selected body or bodies using the thickness of the selected body.
label.translation: Creates a shell part in the middle of the selected body or bodies using the thickness of the selected body.

label.devLabel: Using the Offset Shell command will create a shell to represent the selected body and remove the selected body from the Simulation Model. To recover the original body the Shell must be removed from the timeline, or a new Simulation Model must be created.
label.translation: Using the Offset Shell command will create a shell to represent the selected body and remove the selected body from the Simulation Model. To recover the original body the Shell must be removed from the timeline, or a new Simulation Model must be created.

label.devLabel: Creates a new shell at a specified distance from selected faces of a 3D body.
label.translation: Creates a new shell at a specified distance from selected faces of a 3D body.

label.devLabel: Select multiple faces to offset them simultaneously.
label.translation: Select multiple faces to offset them simultaneously.

label.devLabel: Select the face to offset then specify the distance.
label.translation: Select the face to offset then specify the distance.

label.devLabel: Creates construction surfaces and repairs surface geometry. Access commands to create surface bodies.
label.translation: Creates construction surfaces and repairs surface geometry. Access commands to create surface bodies.

label.devLabel: Select a surface body to reverse the positive direction of all its faces.
label.translation: Select a surface body to reverse the positive direction of all its faces.

label.devLabel: If you have a profile and a single center line selected then create a Revolve feature, the dialog will detect those selections and auto-select the Profile and Axis options.
label.translation: If you have a profile and a single center line selected then create a Revolve feature, the dialog will detect those selections and auto-select the Profile and Axis options.

label.devLabel: You can use the Ruled command to add extensions to existing surfaces, create parting surfaces, or add a drafted surface that follows selected reference geometry.
label.translation: You can use the Ruled command to add extensions to existing surfaces, create parting surfaces, or add a drafted surface that follows selected reference geometry.

label.devLabel: Adjust Type to create ruled surfaces normal or tangent to the face connected to the selected edges, or in a direction that you define.
label.translation: Adjust Type to create ruled surfaces normal or tangent to the face connected to the selected edges, or in a direction that you define.

label.devLabel: Green indicates closed edges, whereas red indicates open edges.
label.translation: Green indicates closed edges, whereas red indicates open edges.

label.devLabel: Use Patch to fill an open body with a new surface. Surfaces can be knit together using the Stitch tool.
label.translation: Use Patch to fill an open body with a new surface. Surfaces can be knit together using the Stitch tool.

label.devLabel: Select the loop to patch then apply connected (G0), tangent (G1), and curvature (G2) boundary conditions.
label.translation: Select the loop to patch then apply connected (G0), tangent (G1), and curvature (G2) boundary conditions.

label.devLabel: Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.
label.translation: Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

label.devLabel: Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.
label.translation: Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

label.devLabel: Use the Project Axis option to project the axis to the same plane as the selected profile. Uncheck to return the axis to its original position.
label.translation: Use the Project Axis option to project the axis to the same plane as the selected profile. Uncheck to return the axis to its original position.

label.devLabel: A suface body itself will not be considered in simulation until it is transformed into a shell and given a thickness.
label.translation: A suface body itself will not be considered in simulation until it is transformed into a shell and given a thickness.

label.devLabel: Transform surface bodies into shells for Simulation.
label.translation: Transform surface bodies into shells for Simulation.

label.devLabel: Sweeps a sketch profile or planar face along a selected path.
label.translation: Sweeps a sketch profile or planar face along a selected path.

label.devLabel: Select the profile then select the sweep path. The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the selected path.
label.translation: Select the profile then select the sweep path. The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the selected path.

label.devLabel: The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the length of the path.
label.translation: The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the length of the path.

label.devLabel: Select the profile and the sweep path.
label.translation: Select the profile and the sweep path.

label.devLabel: Surfaces to be trimmed will turn red.
label.translation: Surfaces to be trimmed will turn red.

label.devLabel: Select a plane or a sketch intersecting a surface as the cutting tool, then select the desired surface to trim.
label.translation: Select a plane or a sketch intersecting a surface as the cutting tool, then select the desired surface to trim.

label.devLabel: Select the faces or bodies to unstitch.
label.translation: Select the faces or bodies to unstitch.

label.devLabel: For the Manual untrim type, hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to suppress the preview and select multiple edges to untrim.
label.translation: For the Manual untrim type, hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to suppress the preview and select multiple edges to untrim.

label.devLabel: Use Untrim to remove unwanted holes or extend and rebuild clean surface intersections.
label.translation: Use Untrim to remove unwanted holes or extend and rebuild clean surface intersections.

label.devLabel: Select the surfaces to check, specify a tolerance then select the type of validation to perform.
label.translation: Select the surfaces to check, specify a tolerance then select the type of validation to perform.

label.translation: Select faces or surface bodies to offset

label.translation: Adjust distance and angle or modify selection
